instruction: I have a Chrome extension zip file on the Desktop. Please install it manually into Chrome and open the chrome://extensions page to confirm it appears in the extensions list.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get install unzip -y && unzip /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip -d /home/user/Desktop/ && rm /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing an unpacked Chrome extension and verifying it appears on chrome://extensions page. Custom getter navigates to chrome://extensions via CDP and extracts page text content. Metric checks if 'Hello Extensions' appears in the page text.

llm_judge_reasons: Semantic verification coverage is complete - evaluator checks if 'Hello Extensions' appears on chrome://extensions page, which correctly verifies the instruction requirement
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' by directly accessing expected.get('extension_name'), not expected.get('rules', {}).get('extension_name')
Getter logic is sound: navigates to chrome://extensions, uses CDP to extract page text content, and has retry logic for robustness
Expected value 'Hello Extensions' correctly matches the extension name from the downloaded file (helloExtension.zip)
Code has proper error handling: websocket ImportError is caught (line 49-52), CDP connection errors are handled (line 63-64), and retry logic is implemented (line 32-77)
Postconfig sleep(1) gives time for extension page to load before verification
Minor issue: Simple substring match could theoretically have false positives, but is acceptable for this specific extension name verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider checking for extension in a more structured way (e.g., looking for specific DOM elements) rather than simple text search, though current approach is acceptable
Could increase sleep time from 2.0s to 3.0s at line 28 to ensure chrome://extensions page fully loads before content extraction
